name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_workers_united_front
title: 工人统一战线
concept: Three distinct streams of small worker silhouettes with differently patterned blank banners converge into one broad forward procession, with a large joined-hands relief at center and faint globe behind. Unity in practical action across national boundaries, flowing composition.
prompt: Create ONE finished Hearts of Iron IV Soviet national focus icon, matching reference 1 frame and bas-relief style but completely replacing central subject. Theme: Three distinct streams of small worker silhouettes with differently patterned blank banners converge into one broad forward procession, with a large joined-hands relief at center and faint globe behind. Unity in practical action across national boundaries, flowing composition. Common frame: deep crimson circular medallion, antique GOLD laurel branches with top gap, red star at top, blank golden ribbon below. Central subject ivory/plaster grey sculpted bas-relief unless specified cold variant, upper-left light, readable dark shadows, bold clear silhouette at 100x88 pixels. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no portrait of a leader. Landscape canvas 100:88 aspect, emblem fills about 94% canvas, 20-50% transparent pixels. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND ENABLED: output RGBA PNG actual alpha zero outside isolated emblem, including all four corners. Never simulate transparency with checkerboard or solid rectangle. Red backing stays inside medallion only.
